_note: Calibration set for the faithfulness judge (v0.5 Slice 3, D42). Each example pairs a QUESTION + the real TOOL RESULTS (ground truth computed in code) with an ANSWER, labelled faithful|unfaithful. 'original' answers are real gpt-5-mini chatbot replies over the synthetic ledger (faithful by construction — every figure comes from the tool). 'corrupted' answers are those same replies with a figure/claim changed or invented (unfaithful by construction). Labels are objective by construction; a human spot-checks and sets human_confirmed. The judge's agreement with these labels is the calibration number (eval_chatbot.py --judge -> CALIBRATION.md). SYNTHETIC — no real personal data.
